Subject: ACME POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jennifer —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before kickoff: 

Key pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent response latency on current vendor endpoints during peak traffic (esp. multi-turn chat).
- High per-token costs for production requests; limited batching/caching in current infra.
- Need for audit logs and stricter data residency for some workloads.

Primary goals for the POC:
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency for chat flows below 350ms for 512-token sequences.
2) Demonstrate a 30% reduction in per-token inference cost using batching + prefix caching.
3) Validate quality via prompt/eval set (target: >=95% pass rate on top-3 intents).

Scope (what we will deliver during the 3-week POC):
- Setup: Redwood-hosted sandbox with a pinned model variant and observability dashboard.
- Eval set: we will run your 150 prompt pairs (we discussed live demo prompts) + Redwood's regression checks.
- Metrics: latency (p50/p95), cost per 1k tokens, quality pass-rate on prompt set, error rate.
- Owners: Ben (sales/coord), Marissa (CS lead), Rishi (infrastructure/provisioning).

Timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access, sample data, and SOW sign-off.
- Week 1: environment setup, baseline runs, and initial tuning.
- Week 2: run prompt/eval set, iterate on batching/quantization profile.
- Week 3: final run + recap + recommendations.

Access/setup steps we need from ACME
1) Add the following IP ranges (provided separately) to allow Redwood sandbox access, or provide a VPN endpoint.
2) Create a service account (scoped to read sample data) and share key via your secure transfer tool (do NOT send keys via email).
3) Share the 150 prompt pairs spreadsheet and a short sample of production traffic (anonymized).

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow.pdf, redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (SOW + checklist attached).

Proposed kickoff meeting: Tue Jun 28, 10:00 AM PT — please confirm or propose an alternate time.

If that all looks right I’ll circulate a short mutual action plan and invite the kickoff meeting.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Ben / Rishi — internal follow-up with a more detailed CS/infra plan so we have clear owners before the kickoff. Feel free to forward to ACME once we finalize.

High-level POC plan (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): whitelist IPs, share creds, confirm prompt set, baseline runs. (Owner: Rishi / ACME)
- Week 1: baseline run + initial kernel/quantization profile testing; enable batching and prefix caching. (Owner: Rishi / Marissa)
- Week 2: run full 150 + 2 additional prompt templates; iterate on batch sizes and cache hit rates. (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 3: final runs, export dashboard, and prepare a short exec summary with cost estimates and recommendations. (Owner: Ben / Marissa)

Success metrics to track (as agreed):
- Latency: p50 / p95 (target p95 < 350ms for 512-token flows)
- Cost: cost per 1k tokens (target >=30% improvement vs ACME baseline)
- Quality: pass rate on eval set (target >=95% on top-3 intents)
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5%

Prompt/eval details:
- Use the attached spreadsheet from ACME as the canonical eval set. We'll run Redwood regression checks plus a few stress runs at higher concurrency.
- Please create a named prompt set in the console: "ACME_POC_v1" and tag the 2 additional templates they provided.

Infra / provisioning notes for Rishi:
- Provision a dedicated sandbox cluster (2x A100-equivalent), enable KV cache and batching, and apply quantization profile "q8_optimized" as a starting point.
- Expose observability dashboard to ACME (read-only) and create a usage dashboard link for the Exec Summary.
